title: Obsolete E-Document Purchase Order Matching Copilot
summary: The five E-Document Purchase Order Matching Copilot objects are marked obsolete pending with tag 29.0 and remain functional during the deprecation window. The feature is superseded by the E-Document Purchase Draft experience, and the shared Matching Assistance Copilot capability stays registered.
key_points: Five Copilot-specific objects in the order matching module are marked ObsoleteState = Pending with ObsoleteTag 29.0
The shared 'E-Document Matching Assistance' Copilot capability remains active for the E-Document AI Tool Processor import flow
Purchase order line matching now handled by the E-Document Purchase Draft experience using codeunit 6196
AI-assisted matching moved to import time via the E-Document AI Tool Processor
No persisted data migration needed as the buffer table is temporary
quote: Obsoletes the E-Document Purchase Order Matching Copilot feature following the Business Central Obsolete lifecycle.
